newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end up as weak yen helps high-tech.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end up as weak yen helps high-tech.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced back on Wednesday as bullish technology stocks in New York overnight and the yen's softening against the dollar encouraged investors to seek high-tech issues, brokers said.
News on Tuesday that the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) would form a strategic alliance also provided support, they said.
The Nikkei 225 closed at 20,358.74, up 289.33 points or 1.44 percent. Its September futures added 360 points to finish the trading session at 20,430.
